descriptionText:
This Marshadow 044/069 s6a Eevee Heroes HOLO RARE Pokemon Card is a must-have for any collector or fan of the Pokemon TCG. With its stunning foil finish and holographic design, this card is sure to catch the eye of anyone who sees it. 

Featuring the psychic type and a basic stage, this card is perfect for any deck. The standard size and Korean language make it a unique addition to any collection. Don't miss your chance to add this autograph-free card to your Pokemon TCG collection today.
